Supplementary lecture A2 · Astronomy: Line strength depends not only on how much of an element there is but also on temperature: hydrogen’s Balmer lines are strongest at ~10,000 K (class A). In hotter stars hydrogen is ionised, while in cooler ones most atoms stay in the ground state. The spectral classes (O, B, A, F, G, K, M) are built on exactly this effect.
